stateController.notes: The route screen translates provider output and initial route fallback through HostOrganizerDetailScreenState, then maps mutation flags into OrganizerDetailBodyState. OrganizerDetailBody receives provider-free next-event, contact-action, host-message eligibility, event-route target, review visibility, and dock state. The consumer membership dock stays screen-local/provider-backed because Host Club Detail suppresses it and no second host/member action-dock contract exists.

composition.currentLayout: OrganizerDetailScreen reads organizerDetailViewModelProvider plus membership/profile streams, maps route/provider branches through HostOrganizerDetailScreenState, maps body policy through OrganizerDetailBodyState, then composes hero, stats, host/about/tag/photo/contact sections, schedule, reviews, and a consumer membership dock.
composition.targetLayout: OrganizerDetailScreen should keep route/provider/mutation policy in screen-state adapters and compose registered sections: hero, stats, host identity, about/tags, photo strip, contact, schedule, reviews, and the screen-local consumer membership dock.

sections.name: Club hero
sections.targetOwner: registered Club Detail hero section with view data and user intents
sections.migration: Move share handling and host badge visibility into a section adapter, then add Widgetbook states for cover/no-cover/collapsed variants.

sections.name: Club stats strip
sections.targetOwner: screen-local section.club.stats until another product screen proves reuse
sections.migration: Keep screen-local for now; promote only if host club detail or another product screen reuses the same club metrics contract.

sections.name: Host identity
sections.targetOwner: registered host identity section plus host-card compound
sections.migration: Provider-free section receives profile visibility, message pending state, and precomputed messageable host ids from OrganizerDetailBodyState.

sections.name: About and tags
sections.migration: Extract about/tag rendering into a provider-free section with explicit long-copy and no-tags states.

sections.name: Club photo strip
sections.migration: Provider-free photo strip has direct Widgetbook states for one-photo and three-photo variants; keep broken-image and many-photo edge cases as future visual variants if needed.

sections.name: Club contact
sections.targetOwner: registered contact section with external-link intents
sections.migration: Provider-free contact section receives typed OrganizerContactAction rows from OrganizerDetailBodyState; URL launching stays behind ExternalLinkController in the route callback.

sections.name: Upcoming schedule
sections.targetOwner: screen-local section.club.schedule until host club detail proves reuse
sections.migration: Move route-name selection and event row view data into an adapter; keep the section screen-local until host club detail reuses the same schedule contract.

sections.name: Club reviews
sections.targetOwner: screen-local section.club.reviews until host/public club reuse is proven
sections.migration: Make review visibility and empty-copy selection explicit screen state instead of branching directly in OrganizerDetailBody; promote after another club-facing screen reuses the same read-only review contract.

sections.name: Membership dock

sections.migration: Decision closed: keep provider-backed OrganizerMembershipDock screen-local and consumer-only. Host Club Detail suppresses this dock, so provider-free CatchOrganizerDock promotion is intentionally deferred until another host/member surface proves the same action dock contract.
